interface.longDescription: Domains for agents. One MCP for everything domains: find, check, buy, set up, watch, move, renew, keep track. Domain Hound finds names and checks registry availability, compares upfront and renewal prices, and screens names for trademarks, app store clashes and web traction. Connect your own Spaceship account to get a live quote, buy with your approval and set up website or mail DNS. You buy through Spaceship’s own MCP, after you approve Spaceship’s confirmation with the price and payment method. Direct purchase is an opt-in in the server settings, and Spaceship checkout is the fallback. It investigates and watches taken domains, plans moves to a cheaper registrar, and keeps track of every domain you own: expiry, DNS, site, email setup and renewal prices. Domain Hound runs on your machine and is open source under the MIT license.
capabilities: Buy and set up DNS at Spaceship
Watch, move and track your domains
